class.name: SliderJoint3D
class.brief_description: A physics joint that restricts the movement of a 3D physics body along an axis relative to another physics body.
class.description: A physics joint that restricts the movement of a 3D physics body along an axis relative to another physics body. For example, Body A could be a [StaticBody3D] representing a piston base, while Body B could be a [RigidBody3D] representing the piston head, moving up and down.

method.name: get_param
method.description: Returns the value of the given parameter.

method.name: set_param
method.description: Assigns [param value] to the given parameter.
